pages.parentText: Sam sat on the mat with a book. A cloud hid the sun. Then drip, drip, drip — drops hit the window. Sam counted three, then laughed as more came. He touched the glass and cried…

popover.mnemonic: ay like in play — two letters, one long /ā/ sound
popover.parentInstruction: Point to a and y together. Say: “These two make /ā/ — day.” Have your child echo day slowly.

pages.parentText: Sam put on his coat and boots. Under the shelf, he found the bright thing he wore on sunny days. He brushed it clean, tried it on, and said…
Sam stepped into the rain. Near the door, a small shape sat in brown mud. Two eyes looked up, and one ear moved. Sam held out his hand and whispered…

popover.mnemonic: ay like in play — two letters, one long /ā/ sound
popover.parentInstruction: Point to a and y together. Say: “These two make /ā/ — may.” Have your child echo may slowly.

pages.parentText: Sam took the little cat in. He dried it and set it on the mat. The cat touched a picture in Sam’s book, then curled close. Sam made a tent with a blanket. They were warm and safe. Sam cried…

popover.mnemonic: ay like in play — a and y holding hands for /ā/
popover.parentInstruction: Cover ay with your finger, then reveal. Child says /ā/, then blends play.
